sentence: This project builds robotic and prosthetic hands that are bio-inspired, have sensing all over, and are customized to the needs of the end-user.
This project builds tools that help artificial intelligence make decisions by understanding causal mechanisms, so its decisions are easier to explain and trust.
This project builds deep learning methods that use mathematical models and measure uncertainty, so predictions for science and engineering problems are more reliable.
This project studies how ancient marine communities responded to climate change and fishing, focusing on baleen whales and their apex predators.
This project builds ways to learn and make decisions from sequential data when the underlying models are unknown, and tests them on monitoring critical infrastructure networks.
This project turns radio frequency sensors into intelligent devices that adjust on their own to people and their environments.
This project studies how metal parts made by fused filament fabrication fail under fatigue tests and how post-processing helps.
This project studies how energy in plasmas is spread out and lost when collisions between charged particles are rare, using computer simulations and machine learning.
This project builds and tests a cryoablation probe and controller that freeze tissue after a lumpectomy to reduce or eliminate remaining cancerous cells.
This project builds an electrochemical device that uses graphene and CRISPR to detect nucleic acids without amplification.
This project asks how artificial intelligence sensing systems can make accurate, timely decisions on small devices with limited resources and still be checked.
This project builds rigorous methods and logics for describing how Cyber-Physical Systems should behave, so they are more robust and reliable.
This project builds a flexible biopsy instrument that takes full thickness samples from tumors growing in hollow organs.
This project tests how well astronomy foundation models learn to generalize and uses them to search for wide interacting binary stars.
This project studies how integrated silicon photonics can make physical unclonable functions that create secure keys for hardware security.
This project builds ways to control large populations of systems using only population-level measurements such as averages and variances.
This project builds a machine learning framework to predict how atoms vibrate in materials and to grow a database of these vibrations.
